issues.description: The public method name for playing the farm song is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement (instructions) and the template declare and ask students to implement public void singFarmSong() (problem_statement.md and template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java), but the reference solution implements the functionality as public void playFarmSong() in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java. The solution's Main.java also still contains a commented call to singFarmSong(). This name mismatch (singFarmSong vs playFarmSong) means the reference implementation does not expose the same public API students are instructed to implement and will confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent across problem statement, template, and solution. Preferred fix: rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong() and update any references in solution Main.java. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to refer to playFarmSong() everywhere. Ensure the exact public method signature matches in all artifacts.
